scope.method: Balanced Markdown destination parsing, HTML href extraction, and bare HTTP(S) mentions outside parsed destinations. changes.md excluded. One unauthenticated streamed GET per exact URL, redirects followed, max concurrency 6, 5s connect/15s read timeout, 4096-byte sample for common challenge text. Reachability only, not content verification.

post_check_source_verification.method: Re-extracted URLs after diagram-block markup changes. URL set and referencing pages equal the HTTP scan snapshot; no HTTP requests repeated. Original occurrence line numbers remain those of the HTTP scan snapshot.
